sourceBaseline.interpretation: The monolith plan query and authenticated free-tier downgrade are compatibility evidence and findings; an authority failure is not an entitlement decision and is not preserved as a production target.

evidence.anchor: warn!("Analytics API: Failed to get offset for {}: {}, using free tier", wallet, e);

targetBase.interpretation: Immutable post-A2.5 snapshot before lazy identity transport and fail-closed authenticated authority handling.

invariants.claim: An anonymous rankings request retains the free-plan offset without invoking the identity authority or requiring identity availability.
A verified wallet must receive a successful ranking-offset authority decision before authenticated rankings provider work can begin.
An authenticated authority error becomes a sanitized ServiceUnavailable result and returns before any market provider invocation.
A valid identity endpoint constructs a lazy tonic channel without dialing during analytics startup or anonymous request handling.
An authenticated authority lookup performs one RPC attempt under one 100 millisecond deadline with no retry beneath the query port.
Identity status, transport, timeout and invalid-wire failures return an error rather than invoking or synthesizing a free-plan fallback.
Successful wire offsets use strict RankingOffset validation; invalid negative or oversized values fail rather than clamp to Free Plan.
Authority status text, endpoint credentials, wallet identifiers and transport details are not copied into the client-visible error.
A single valid authority result is preserved unchanged for backend-owned ranking pagination and does not derive policy from token claims.
All A2.6 evidence is offline or in-process and authorizes no database, identity network, provider, listener, browser, deployment or production action.

residualStops.claim: The identity gRPC server still returns the Free Plan offset for every successful request, so paid entitlement success is not authoritative.
The identity service has no reviewed database repository, atomic plan snapshot, schema probe, assignment reconciliation or live plan authority.
The internal identity RPC has no authenticated workload identity, owner binding, transport TLS or authorization policy.
Identity ranking SSE and emit remain unauthenticated, global, ephemeral and disconnected from transactional entitlement changes.
Free, paid, expired, overlapping, revoked and admin assignment parity has no reconciled fixture ledger or source-shadow evidence.
The monolith remains canonical and no gateway, Cloudflare, Kubernetes, image, configuration, canary or rollback cutover is authorized.
No database, RPC, service listener, browser, staging, load, observability, deployment or rollback evidence exists for A2.6.
Passing A2.6 integrity is not production readiness and never authorizes a live service, secret, database, provider or deployment action.

requiredExecutionOrder: E01 freeze the source downgrade and immutable post-A2.5 target base
E02 enforce authenticated authority failure before provider invocation
E03 construct the identity client lazily with no Free-plan fallback or retry
E04 prove strict wire validation, opaque errors, one attempt and anonymous bypass with in-process fakes
E05 implement and reconcile one authoritative atomic plan-assignment read behind identity
E06 add authenticated workload identity, owner binding and transport protection
E07 remove or secure the global SSE and emit surfaces with durable event semantics
E08 obtain separate integration, shadow, canary, rollback and deployment authorization
